generation_environment.encoding_command: ffmpeg -framerate 30 -i frames/frame_%04d.png -frames:v 600 -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 16 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart candidate.mp4

full_generation_config.surface_texture: subtle axial colour bands, illustrative rather than observed fiber orientation
full_generation_config.scope: fixed qualitative rapid rupture with longitudinal branched remnants; strand count and geometry authored, reinforcement and layup unknown

source.dense_observation: first four extracted frames intact narrow segment; next frames show short branched upper residue and a gap. Exact onset cannot be calibrated beyond low frame rate and label/visible bracket.

time_mapping.purpose: continuous small loading then rapid mechanical multiple fracture surfaces and local strand splitting, finite decay, stopped observation; no loop/padding
time_mapping.source_timing_uncertainty: original event25.29s is dataset label; visible state changes between supplied25.29 and25.34frames;30fps cannot resolve physical crack speed

observations: Original sheet identifies composite and explosive fracture, event25.29s; it does not establish constituent identity, free-fragment count or formal gauge.
Source before event already contains thin red/black measurement leads and attachment; these are not new flying material fibers.
Source changes rapidly from a narrow continuous strip-like segment to a visible gap with several short strand-like upper remnants. Lower remnant is partly occluded and blurred.
No reliable free material fragment trajectories or actual explosion/flame are established by these pixels. Blue apparatus light changes do not prove blast.
modelling_assumptions: One narrow solid strip before event, subdivided into six unequal axial visual bundles during simultaneous multiple complementary ruptures; six is an author choice, not a measured fiber count.
Specific axial bands, irregular cut heights and local splay are schematic surface/geometry assumptions, not validated reinforcement direction, layup, architecture or microscopic mechanism.
All material remains in upper/lower anchored branched remnants; detached fragments are zero because their identity/trajectories cannot be reliably distinguished from pre-existing measurement wires.
Piecewise affine local lateral shear with actual z coordinates retained makes complementary fracture faces visibly separate without removing a strip or shortening the fragments.

Abrupt event at16s, local bounded splay oscillation decays over1.5s; jaws stop at event and root material remains attached. This is a selected qualitative boundary condition, not calibrated source damping.
Only the fixed baseline configuration is supplied; no valid continuous parameter range is inferred.
unknowns: Exact reinforcement constituent, matrix, grade, fiber diameter, fiber orientation, ply count, weave/layup and microscopic failure mechanism.
Physical specimen dimensions, formal source gauge, load/strain history, constitutive law, crack propagation speed and damping.
Actual number of strand branches, free fragments or three-dimensional postfracture trajectories; low-resolution measurement attachment obscures parts of source.

材料类别.evidence: original XLSX row identifies composite; not inferred from appearance

断裂结果.evidence: 独立600帧实际求值显示第481帧贯通路径丧失，2个分量各夹持一端；最终编码481及末态可见分束与背景开口。

单一主要破坏类别.evidence: 原标签爆炸性；最终编码与来源支持快速断开/多个短残束，不能单独核验爆炸性分类，保留无法确认。

断裂位置.evidence: all authored fracture faces lie inside synthetic gauge z[-1.5,1.5]; source formal gauge unknown

夹持异常.evidence: 600 actual evaluated jaw inner-face contact and embedded extent checks; each final component remains attached to one jaw

拍摄异常.evidence: 独立核验固定相机、全程入画、960×540/600帧30fps20秒、完整解码及主Agent实际打开最终视频。

summary.loading_volume_interpretation: small authored axial stretch without Poisson contraction, not an incompressibility or quantitative material assertion; rupture and lateral shear preserve loaded material volume
summary.scope_limit: evaluated surface edge graph, signed closed-surface material volume, corresponding source-coordinate edge/section measurements and cap/adjacent boundary separating-axis clearances; no full swept triangle collision or constitutive solver
summary.adjacent_boundary_gap_method: source-coordinate pairs on actual opposing neighbour boundary polygons, side ownership inferred from outward normals, signed right-minus-left; not merely absolute spread
